acceptance: A carryover todo with verifiableBy exiting 0 on the fresh base is retired pre-dispatch (logged + annotated), and the lane picks different work — regression test with a fixture todo whose command is 'true'.
A todo with verifiableBy exiting non-zero dispatches normally; a todo without verifiableBy dispatches normally (no false retirement) — table-driven.
Retirement is transactional with the todo store write (no consume-without-record).
Wave summary line reports retired count (no silent caps).

fix: Audit prescription verbatim (cycle-1479 audit-report.md): 'Retire a fleet lane once its verifiableBy command exits 0 on HEAD: run the todo's verifiableBy before dispatch and drop the lane instead of dispatching a satisfied contract.' Implement at lane-mint/triage boundary: if the todo carries verifiableBy, execute it against the fresh worktree base; exit 0 => retire the todo (annotate retired_at/retired_by=predispatch-probe, surface in the wave summary — no silent drops), pick the next backlog item. Todos WITHOUT verifiableBy are exempt (no false retirement); tighten authoring guidance so carryovers ship a verifiableBy. Deterministic Go, zero LLM tokens.

root_cause: Lane selection trusts carryoverTodos/backlog freshness with no pre-dispatch satisfaction probe. A todo whose acceptance already holds on HEAD is indistinguishable from live work at triage time; the whole spine then runs to prove a no-op (honest WARN, ~2M tokens wasted).
